headline: Callahan's Passage Surges Anew as Weathered Expanse Stirs
war_summary: Callahan's Passage has retaken the liveliest corner of the map, twenty-five base actions in the day's ledger with fresh movement filed as this edition goes to press; Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage each logged eleven exchanges, and the casualty returns there climb steeply, Warden losses near 1,300 and Colonial some 830 over the past two hours. The Weathered Expanse, still through the small hours, has woken again with three actions inside two hours, though its butcher's bill remains the war's heaviest—roughly 12,700 Warden and 8,400 Colonial casualties across the day. The Nevish Line keeps seething, twenty-five actions behind it and six of its eight posts now flying Warden colors against two Colonial, Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way the storm centers. Palantine Berm, yesterday's busiest ground, counts thirty-one actions yet scarce a breath in the final two hours, and the Stlican Shelf saw heavy traffic around Breaker Town before falling still near eight o'clock. Kuura Strand and Mooring County have likewise gone quiet. It is day 473; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
